name: Jungle Story Wall Panel
shortDescription: A deep-relief wall panel depicting a lush jungle scene of wildlife.
description: A dramatic relief panel that tells a story in wood — elephants, deer, a leopard and a peacock gather beneath a spreading tree, carved in multiple layers of depth. Designed to hang as a striking piece of wall art, it brings a sense of narrative and craftsmanship to any room.

faqs.question: Can it be hung on a wall?
faqs.answer: Yes, the panel is designed for wall mounting and includes a fixing point on the reverse.

faqs.question: How long does a panel like this take?
faqs.answer: A deep-relief panel of this detail can take several weeks of carving by an experienced artisan.

faqs.question: Is the scene painted?
faqs.answer: No. All depth and detail come from hand-carving; the finish is a natural matte polish.
